# Published11 empty worker inherited native actor

`control.lua` is a `__level__` scenario actor, not a mod control. Create a fresh scenario save under exact Base plus publishedMIR4.7 only, then retain the same embedded actor unchanged through published5.0.11 and candidate5.0.17 loads. Its scenario storage records only its own administrative baseline; it never reads or writes MIR storage.

The source labels administrative setup explicitly: it unlocks `automation-science-pack`, then records player automation at27% with queued logistics and detached steel processing at31%, plus a separate lab force with worker1–3 prerequisites, foreign carrying bonus7.25 and laboratory speed3600. Every source worker4 is empty. The candidate must preserve those sentinels, observe an uninvested default owner/debit, then complete exactly one ordinary `mir-worker-storage-default-4` research with five675-pack inputs and `by_script=false` before saving.

The actor’s lab sentinel is deliberately split into the verified Base worker1–3 bonus of3 and an actor-owned4.25 contribution, plus its actor-owned speed3600. At the published11 and candidate17 configuration callbacks it records the corresponding raw engine marker before restoring only the exact3/0 engine-reset tuple; an already7.25/3600 tuple is retained and every other value refuses. The subsequent before-configuration markers therefore record the post-actor, pre-MIR frame. Candidate16 negatives and cold paths never apply that restoration.

The old selection remains Base+MIR only. The startup-change leg has only Base and candidate MIR; the addition leg adds only `inert-addition/info.json` forF210 or `inert-addition/info-f200.json` forF200, each with no data or control stage. Both legs require a genuine4.7 -> published11 configuration, then exact same-edition published11 -> candidate events. The actor cannot inspect the private MIR route marker: its absence is provenance from the published11 reader and real configuration path, not an invented observer fact.

The owning controller binds the four source/candidate archive identities, exact engine, settings, scenario actor and inert addition separately. It waits for `source473-saved.json`, `engine-before-scenario-restoration.json`, `inherited11-before-configuration.json`, `inherited11-saved.json`, `candidate-engine-before-scenario-restoration.json`, candidate `before-configuration.json`, `candidate-saved.json`, and two read-only `cold.json` records. This fixture prepares a native qualification; host controls and scenario setup do not prove native research, preservation, saves, or cold loads.
